title: 第二十七章 缠上第二十八章 狭路相逢
lines: 第二十七章：缠上
阳光踏着海面而来，温馨明媚的一天开始了，林昆一大清早就起来了，穿着背心大裤衩子，在车库前的那块小菜地上忙活，过去在乡下，他每年都干农活，刨地种菜都是一把手，现在虽然很久没干了，但依旧娴熟。
菜地一直也没被种过，表面的泥土硬邦邦的，林昆先用镐头松了遍土，然后刨出垄沟，这块小菜地约有四五十个平方，一共刨出了十个垄沟，把昨天下午买的菜籽分别中上，浇水培土，暂时就算大功告成了。
一顿忙活下来，已经快早上六点钟了，林昆抬起沾满泥土的手擦了把汗，收拾好了工具，回到家先冲了个凉，然后便钻进厨房里做早餐。
正常的男人都视厨房为禁地，林昆却是乐在其中，把一堆食材通过自己的双手，烹饪出美味的菜肴，是一件很有创造性也很有乐趣的事儿。
早餐简单，但营养搭配的很合理，这是林昆在炊事班里跟老军厨子学的，别看部队里都是一大堆的糙老爷们，但在饮食方面可是相当讲究的。
自从林昆来了以后，楚静瑶感觉到最直接的好处就是她不用进厨房了，而且这个打着儿子爸爸旗号的流氓厨子的手艺还出奇的好，甚至她自己都自叹不如，再加上他的出现让儿子变的比以前更开心了，也有父爱了，楚静瑶偶尔的时候也会想，这个臭流氓还是有那么点优点的，而且经过了昨天晚上的按摩，她的脚踝今天早上几乎不怎么疼了。
一家三口吃完早餐，楚静瑶带着小楚澄到楼上换衣服了，林昆收拾完餐桌，也到楼上换衣服了，他今天还是没穿秦雪带着他去买的名牌，依旧昨天那一身地摊货的行头，没办法他骨头贱，穿不惯那好衣服。
其实，林昆的想法挺简单，穿着那么一套上千块的衣服，不管干点什么都有心有顾忌，害怕刮了蹭了的，自己的这一身衣服也没几个钱，刮了蹭了的也不用心疼。
一家三口出门，楚静瑶突然想起了什么，回过头问林昆：“你的车呢？”
林昆呲牙笑道：“坏了，送维修厂了。”
楚静瑶轻轻蹙眉，嗔怪道：“像你那么开车的，什么车能经得起折腾？”说着从包里拿出了个车钥匙：“这是我另一辆车的钥匙，你先开着。”
“不用，你的车除了那辆卡罗卡，都太高调了，我是个喜欢低调的人。”林昆笑着道。
“呵，你就放心吧，高调的车我才不舍得借你开呢，回头给我开进维修厂怎么办？”楚静瑶白了他一眼，想起昨天早上在马路上飙车的情景，心底没由来的一阵刺激，那感觉就好像自己投入到了电影里一样。
“哦……”林昆笑着接过了车钥匙，拿在手里一看，是个奇瑞标志的，还真够低调，只是不知道是奇瑞的哪一款车，回头朝车库看了一眼。
楚静瑶看到了车库前的菜地的变化，回过头问林昆：“这是怎么回事？”
小楚澄也发现了菜地跟以前不同了，却不知道这是怎么回事，他一个从小在城里长大的孩子，没见过种菜也正常，眼神好奇的看向爸爸。
“我看着这菜地空着怪可惜得了，昨天下午就买了点种子回来，今早上给种上了。”林昆笑着道：“等过个两三个月，咱就能吃上新鲜的蔬菜了。”
“你还会种菜？”楚静瑶有些惊讶。
“当然会了。”林昆嘴角一笑，“我可是在农村长大的，会的东西多了去了。”
楚静瑶呵呵的笑了，她挺喜欢田园风的生活，否则也不会把别墅装修成了田园风格，之前她就想过在这块小菜地上种点什么，可惜她不会，现在好了，来了一个会的大能人，要说这家里还是得有个男人靠谱。
小楚澄仰起小脑袋，高兴又天真的问林昆：“爸爸，这菜地里能长出人参果么？”
“那钻石呢？”
“不能。”
“香蕉呢？”
“也不能……”
“哎……”小家伙惆怅似的叹了口气，“什么都长不出，还种什么菜呀。”

Chapter 27: Get entangled
The sun came over the sea, and the warm and bright day began. Lin Kun got up early in the morning, wearing a vest and large pants, and worked on the small vegetable patch in front of the garage. In the past, in the countryside, he did farm work every year, and was the best at digging and planting vegetables. Although he hasn't done it for a long time, he is still skillful.
The vegetable field had never been planted before, and the soil on the surface was hard. Lin Kun first loosened the soil with a pickaxe, and then dug out furrows. This small vegetable field was about forty or fifty square meters, and a total of ten furrows were dug out. He put the rapeseeds he bought yesterday afternoon in the middle and top, watered and cultivated the soil, and he was done for the time being.
After a busy day, it was almost six o'clock in the morning. Lin Kun raised his muddy hands and wiped the sweat, packed his tools, took a shower when he got home, and then got into the kitchen to make breakfast.
Normal men regard the kitchen as a forbidden place, but Lin Kun enjoys it. Using a bunch of ingredients to cook delicious dishes with his own hands is a very creative and fun thing.
Breakfast is simple, but the nutritional mix is ​​very reasonable. This is what Lin Kun learned from veteran army cooks in the cooking class. Even though there are a lot of rough men in the army, they are very particular about diet.
Since Lin Kun came, Chu Jingyao felt that the most immediate benefit was that she no longer had to go into the kitchen, and the skills of this rogue cook who pretended to be her son's father were surprisingly good, and she even felt inferior to her. In addition, his appearance made her son happier than before, and he also had fatherly love. Chu Jingyao occasionally thought that this stinky rogue still had some merits, and after last night's massage, her ankle hardly hurt this morning.
After the family of three finished breakfast, Chu Jingyao took little Chu Cheng upstairs to change clothes. Lin Kun cleaned up the dining table and went upstairs to change clothes. He still didn't wear the famous brand Qin Xue took him to buy today. He still wore the same clothes from the street stall yesterday. There was no way he was cheap and couldn't get used to wearing those good clothes.
In fact, Lin Kun's idea is quite simple. He is wearing such a set of clothes that costs thousands of dollars. No matter what he does, he has scruples. He is afraid of getting scratched. He doesn't have much money for this outfit, so he doesn't feel bad if he gets scratched.
As a family of three went out, Chu Jingyao suddenly remembered something and turned back to ask Lin Kun: "Where is your car?"
Lin Kun bared his teeth and said with a smile: "It's broken, send it to the repair shop."
Chu Jingyao frowned slightly and said angrily: "If you drive like you, what car can withstand the torment?" Then she took out a car key from her bag: "This is the key to my other car. You drive it first."
"No, your cars, except for the Caroca, are all too high-profile. I am a person who likes to keep a low profile." Lin Kun said with a smile.
"Oh, don't worry. I'm not willing to lend you a high-profile car to drive. What if you drive it to the repair shop later?" Chu Jingyao rolled her eyes at him, remembering the scene of racing on the road yesterday morning, and there was an unreasonable excitement in her heart. It felt like she was in a movie.
"Oh..." Lin Kun smiled and took the car key. He took it in his hand and saw that it was a Chery logo. It was really low-key, but he didn't know which Chery car it was. He turned around and glanced at the garage.
"Huh?"
Chu Jingyao saw the changes in the vegetable patch in front of the garage and turned back to ask Lin Kun: "What's going on?"
Little Chucheng also discovered that the vegetable field was different from before, but he didn't know what was going on. As a child who grew up in the city, it was normal for him to never see vegetables growing. He looked at his father curiously.
"I saw it was a pity that the vegetable field was empty. I bought some seeds yesterday afternoon and planted them this morning." Lin Kun said with a smile: "In two or three months, we will be able to eat fresh vegetables."
"You can also grow vegetables?" Chu Jingyao was a little surprised.
"Of course I can." Lin Kun smiled, "I grew up in a rural area, so I know a lot of things."
Chu Jingyao laughed. She liked the pastoral style life, otherwise she would not have decorated the villa in a pastoral style. She had thought about planting something on this small vegetable plot before, but unfortunately she didn't know how. Now, a capable person has come. If you want to say that this family still needs a reliable man.
Little Chu Cheng raised her little head and asked Lin Kun happily and innocently: "Dad, can ginseng fruits grow in this vegetable field?"
"Uh...can't."
"What about diamonds?"
"Can't."
"Where's the banana?"
"Can't..."
"Hey..." The little guy sighed melancholy, "Nothing can grow, so why should we grow vegetables?"
